meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可启动本地 Dashboard 查看拆文库、写作项目和编辑文本。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、$story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 启动网络小说写作工作台，管理拆文与项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在创作网络小说，需要工具管理拆文和写作流程
copy.tagline_en: Launch the web novel writing dashboard to manage breakdowns and projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are writing web novels and need a tool to manage breakdowns and writing processes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成一个网文工具箱路由入口。当你提出关于写小说、拆文、扫榜等模糊请求时，它会自动判断你的意图，并调用对应的子技能（如写长篇、拆短篇、去 AI 味等）来处理。
howto.when: 当你说出“/story”、“/网文”、“我想写小说”等指令，或提出关于网文写作、拆解、扫榜等模糊请求时触发。

say.note: 会询问你写长篇还是短篇，然后路由到对应技能。
路由到长篇拆文技能，分析结构。
检查工具箱新版本，并询问是否更新。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a router for web novel tools. When you make vague requests about writing, analyzing, or scanning web novels, it identifies your intent and delegates to specific sub-skills (e.g., long-form writing, short-story analysis, AI-rewriting).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say /story, /网文, or natural phrases like "I want to write a novel", or any vague request about web novel creation, analysis, or trending lists.

say_en.text: I want to write a novel
say_en.note: Asks long or short form, then routes.
Checks version and asks to upgrade.
